caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a young boy standing barefoot on a square, four-tiled pedestal. The boy has dark skin and short, textured hair. He is dressed in loose-fitting clothes: a red, short-sleeved shirt draped off one shoulder and a pair of greyish-black pants with rolled-up cuffs. The boy's right arm is extended forward and slightly upward, holding a metallic object that appears to be a large ring or shackle. His left hand is clenched into a loose fist and rests by his side. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, with a simple beige or light tan color that enhances the focus on the figure and pedestal. The overall composition is centered, with the figure displayed in a three-quarter view facing to the right.
title: Hitching Post
